definition_used: An investigation by the United States Office of Research Integrity (ORI).
caution: The definition only states that an investigation by ORI occurred, without specifying what was investigated or the outcome. It does not directly indicate a problem with research content, authorship, editorial processes, or post-publication transparency. It is a procedural signal that may be associated with any of these categories, but alone it is insufficient to assign a manuscript-facing category.
semantic_rationale: The definition describes an investigation by a government oversight body (ORI) into research integrity. This is a process signal (official_misconduct_process) with actor_context ori_government. No specific problem_object is mentioned, and the definition does not inherently imply a particular manuscript-facing category; it could relate to any of them depending on the investigation's focus. Therefore, no manuscript category is assigned.
